constraints: Hospital shifts, protected sleep blocks, and existing fixed events were not moved or deleted. The friend's birthday dinner on Thursday remains at 2026-11-26T20:00:00+00:00.
The two clinical questionnaire sessions are scheduled inside the stated outpatient clinic hours of 09:00 to 12:30 on weekdays: Wednesday 09:00-11:00 and Thursday 09:00-11:00.
Because the user is not already staying at the hospital for these morning sessions, 30-minute commutes each way were added for both data-collection visits.

The final calendar keeps at least two hours of thesis time on each of Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. The Thursday abstract block adds the requested extra three hours of thesis/writing work before the Friday 14:00 deadline.
Scheduled time does not prove the clinical work or submission will be completed; coordinator availability, patient flow, room access, and submission-system readiness are operational dependencies.
priorities: Complete patient data collection before Friday evening with buffer by finishing the second session on Thursday morning.
Finish the conference abstract work before the Friday 14:00 deadline rather than leaving it to Friday morning.
Protect fixed work shifts, eight-hour sleep blocks, meals already represented in the calendar, and the friend's birthday dinner.
Drop lower-priority gym sessions where they conflict with clinic hours and deadline work. The Wednesday and Thursday gym sessions are dropped; the Friday gym session remains unchanged.
Use flexible thesis, lunch, and errands blocks for reorganisation rather than disturbing fixed/protected events.

alternatives_considered.option: Collect data on Thursday and Friday instead of Wednesday and Thursday.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: This is calendar-feasible, but it leaves less buffer before Friday evening and would put Friday morning under more pressure near the 14:00 abstract deadline and the afternoon hospital shift.

alternatives_considered.option: Stay at the hospital on Wednesday after the 09:00-11:00 data collection session until the 15:00 shift.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: That would depend on suitable hospital space for lunch and thesis work, which is not supplied, and it would also make the existing fixed 14:30 commute-to-work event operationally inconsistent.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep the Thursday gym session and move the second data-collection session elsewhere.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The gym is a lower-priority flexible preference, while data collection is limited to clinic hours and depends on the outpatient clinic. Keeping gym would either reduce buffer or push clinical work into Friday.

alternatives_considered.option: Use Friday morning for abstract writing and submission.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Friday already has the usual thesis block, gym, lunch, commute, and fixed hospital shift. Completing the extra abstract work on Thursday gives a safer margin before the Friday 14:00 deadline.

rationale.summary: This proposal schedules clinical data collection for Wednesday and Thursday 09:00-11:00, with required commutes added because the user is not already at the hospital. It drops the Wednesday and Thursday gym sessions, keeps Friday gym, preserves all protected sleep and fixed work events, keeps the friend's birthday dinner, and adds a three-hour Thursday abstract-writing-and-submission block before the Friday 14:00 deadline. The key confirmation needed from the outpatient nurse coordinator is that Wednesday 09:00-11:00 and Thursday 09:00-11:00 are acceptable collection windows and that the clinic can provide access to patients, space, and any required materials during those sessions.
